Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram, Court's or Judge's

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Mr. T.U. Tathod, Advocate for applicant.
 Mr. J.Y. Ghurde, App for non-applicant No.1.
 Coram: Vinay Joshi And
 M. W. Chandwani, Jj.
Dated : 18/12/2023.
Heard.
2. The applicant is seeking to quash charge-sheet arising out of Crime No. 35/2021 registered with
Police Station Ramdaspeth, Akola, Tah. and Dist. Akola for the offence punishable under Sections
420, 406, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
It is the contention of the applicant that the complainant is his nephew.
Main accused Shrikant Banu Bokade represented to the complainant that he would provide job him as a Clerk in State Bank of India under the management quota.

The complaint informed the same to the present applicant,
who also talked to the main accused Shrikant Bokade and also paid the amount to him for job of his son and one Laxmibai Mankar.
Accused Shrikant Bokade issued fake orders of appointment to the complainant as well as son of the applicant, apart from Laxmibai.
Therefore, on the basis of complaint, initially offences were came to be registered against accused Shrikant Bokade and other accused.

During the course of 2 909 apl 827.22 investigation, statement of Santosh Mankar,
husband of Laxmibai was recorded.
The present applicant has been made as an accused on the allegation that he had taken the amount from Laxmibai Mankar.
It is contended that the applicant himself is victim, but the Police unnecessarily roped him in this crime.
Sanjay S/O Shankarrao Pranjale vs The State Of Mah.
